original_high_level_goal.name: Foster Community Engagement and Transparency
original_high_level_goal.description: Provide citizens with the ability to view public reports, follow other citizens' reports, and receive notifications, enhancing community involvement and trust in the reporting process.

actor.name: Citizens
actor.description: Individuals who report issues and malfunctions in the urban environment.

branch_002.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate citizen engagement and transparency in urban issue reporting.
branch_002.rationale: Grounding: The parent HLG is supported by Section C, which details features for viewing public reports, following others, and receiving notifications to strengthen trust. The reconstructed HLG is also supported as it accurately summarizes the intent of these transparency and engagement features. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG accurately captures the core functional intention of fostering engagement and transparency as defined in the parent HLG and supported by the documentation. It preserves the citizen actor perspective and the high-level objective of enhancing trust through reporting features.

original_high_level_goal.name: Efficiently review and manage citizen reports
original_high_level_goal.description: To ensure that submitted citizen reports are thoroughly reviewed and appropriately managed, leading to timely approvals or rejections and effective assignment for resolution.

actor.name: Municipal Operators
actor.description: Staff members of the Municipality of Turin who review and manage citizen reports.

branch_003.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective management and resolution of citizen reports by municipal operators.
branch_003.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly details the review, approval, rejection, and assignment processes performed by the Organization Office and technical staff, supporting the parent HLG. The reconstructed HLG accurately summarizes these management and resolution activities described in sections B and C. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention of managing and resolving citizen reports by municipal operators, aligning with the parent's focus on review and assignment. While it condenses the specific outcomes (approval/rejection), it maintains the same actor perspective and high-level objective supported by the documentation.

original_high_level_goal.name: Ensure timely resolution of urban issues through effective communication and status updates
original_high_level_goal.description: Facilitate the process for external maintenance personnel to update report statuses and communicate with technical staff, ensuring that reported urban issues are resolved effectively.

actor.name: External Maintenance Personnel
actor.description: Workers from external companies who address specific issues reported by citizens.

branch_004.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective communication and resolution of reported issues by external maintenance personnel.
branch_004.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly details the workflow for external maintenance personnel, including their ability to update report statuses (e.g., from Assigned to In Progress to Resolved) and communicate with technical staff. The reconstructed HLG accurately captures this functional intention of facilitating resolution and communication by these specific actors. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention by maintaining the same actor (external maintenance personnel) and objective (facilitating communication and resolution of issues). Although it omits specific details like 'status updates' and 'urban issues', these are acceptable simplifications that do not alter the fundamental WHY-level goal.

original_high_level_goal.name: Oversee System Operations and Configuration Management
original_high_level_goal.description: Manage and maintain the Participium system to ensure its reliability, security, and continuous improvement, including viewing private statistics and managing system configurations.

actor.name: Administrators
actor.description: Individuals who manage the Participium system and oversee its operations.

branch_005.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective system management and oversight by administrators.
branch_005.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly defines administrator roles in Section D (viewing private statistics) and Section B (configuring automatic assignments), supporting the parent HLG. The reconstructed HLG accurately summarizes these administrative oversight and configuration responsibilities. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core intention of administrative oversight and system management defined in the parent HLG. It maintains the same actor perspective and functional scope, albeit with less specific detail regarding configuration and statistics.
